name: 200 kW chilled-water CRAH
summary: Perimeter chilled-water computer room air handler with EC fans, about 200 kW sensible.

capacityW.note: Top of the Vertiv Liebert PCW range, which covers about 66–210 kW.

fanPowerW.note: Specific fan power of 0.8 kW per m³/s for EC fans at typical CRAH static pressure × 13.8 m³/s = 11 kW, about 5.5 % of capacity.

capexUsd.note: About 400 USD per kW (judgment for chilled-water CRAHs with EC fans and controls), equipment only.

leadTimeWeeks.note: Judgment: CRAHs are catalogue items with shorter queues than CDUs or chillers.
